home.description: AltVision automatically generates precise alt text for your images by analyzing both the image and its surrounding context. The plugin considers headings, paragraphs, and captions near the image to create highly relevant descriptions. Stop spending hours writing manual descriptions – let AI do the heavy lifting!

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AltVision.

items.q: How accurate is the AI-generated alt text?
items.a: AltVision reads both the image and the content around it — nearby headings, paragraphs, and captions — to write descriptions that fit the context, not just the pixels. Suggestions occasionally need light tweaking, but they give you an accurate, accessibility-ready starting point in seconds.
JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and BMP, up to 16 MB per image.

items.q: How many languages does AltVision support?
items.a: 31 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, and Japanese. You pick the output language so the alt text matches your content.

items.q: Can I add my own SEO keywords?
items.a: Yes. Add custom keywords before generating and AltVision works them into the description to improve image search visibility while keeping the text natural.

items.q: Does it help with accessibility compliance?
items.a: Yes. AltVision is built to support WCAG 2.1 alt-text requirements. The browser extension also highlights images missing alt text and lets you inspect existing alt text and aria-labels directly on the page.

The WordPress plugin installs like any other plugin and works with both the classic editor and Gutenberg, right inside the media library. The browser extension installs in one click from the Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons.
You can try AltVision for free with a daily limit. Upgrade to premium for unlimited generations.
Images are processed only to generate their descriptions and are not used for anything else. See our Privacy Policy for the full details.
